title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy the First Amendment to Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Gillette Company.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating in the decision were: Paul G. Afonso. Chairman; Commiccioners W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 03-21)
